name: Vienna Gambit accepted: 6.d4 dxe5 7.Qe2

name: Danish: 7.e5 Ng4? 8.Bxf7+ Kxf7 9.Qd5+

name: Danish: 5...Nf6 6.e5 Qe7 7.Qe2

name: Danish: 3...Qe7 4.cxd4 Qxe4+ 5.Be3

name: Fried Liver: 7...Kg8?? smothered finish

name: Traxler: 6.Kf1 Qe7 7.Nxh8 d5 8.exd5 Nd4 9.c3 Bg4 10.Qa4+ Nd7

name: Traxler: 6.Kf1 Qe7 7.Nxh8 d5 8.Bxd5? Bg4 queen trap

name: King's Gambit Accepted 3.Nf3

name: Jerome Gambit 4.Bxf7+ Kxf7 5.Nxe5+ Nxe5 6.Qh5

name: Ponziani 4...exd4 5.e5 Nd5 6.Bc4

name: Ponziani 3...d5 4.Qa4 dxe4 5.Nxe5 Bd7? 6.Nxd7 Qxd7 7.Qxe4+

name: Ponziani 3...d5 4.Qa4 f6 5.Bb5

idea: Against Black's best, ...f6 shoring up e5, add pressure on the pinned knight with the bishop and then challenge the center and castle.

name: Ponziani 3...d5 4.Qa4 Bd7 5.exd5
videoTitle: The BEST Beginner Chess Opening

name: Scotch 3...d6 4.dxe5 dxe5 5.Qxd8+ Kxd8

name: Scotch Potter: 4...Bc5 5.Nb3 Bb4+ 6.c3 Be7 7.f4

name: Scotch Mieses 6...Nd5? 7.c4 Nb6 8.Bd3

name: Scotch Mieses 6...Ne4? 7.Qf3

name: Scotch 4...Qf6 5.Nb5

name: Scotch 4...Qh4 5.Nc3 Bc5 6.Be3
videoTitle: A Magical Chess Opening for ALL Levels
idea: Against the early queen, don't trade on c6 into a mating attack; hold d4 with Be3, castle long and later kick the queen with Nf5 and g3.

name: Ruy Lopez 3...a6 4.Bxc6 dxc6 5.Nxe5? Qd4

name: Ulvestad 5...b5 6.dxc6 bxc4
videoTitle: TOP 8 BEST Chess Openings
idea: If White grabs the c6-knight, Black takes the c4-bishop; Black gets quick development, castles, and aims both bishops (d6 and b7) at the white king.

name: Stafford 5.Nc3 Bc5
videoTitle: Teaching TierZoo #2: Easy Openings for Black
idea: Against Nc3 the bishop still goes to c5 aiming at f2, with ...Ng4, ...Qd4 and ...Bg4 ideas; Black plays for a quick attack and castles, a pawn down.

name: Stafford 5.e5 Qe7 6.Qe2 Nd5
videoTitle: Teaching TierZoo #2: Easy Openings for Black
idea: Instead of moving the attacked knight, pin the e5 pawn with ...Qe7; after Qe2 the knight goes to d5 with ...Nb4 jumps toward c2, then Black regains the pawn and castles long.

name: vs 2.Qh5: 2...Nc6 3.Bc4 g6 4.Qf3 Nf6 5.g4 Nd4
videoTitle: How To PUNISH Early Queen Attacks In Chess
idea: Defend e5 with the knight, block the f7 threat with ...g6 and ...Nf6, and when White lunges with g4 counterattack with ...Nd4, hitting the queen and c2; the early queen becomes a target.

name: Vienna 2...Bc5 3.Bc4 Qg5 4.d4 Qxg2 5.Qh5
videoTitle: THE BEST BEGINNER OPENING (Chess Slowrun)
idea: Against the early ...Qg5, give up g2 with d4 to open the c1-bishop; Qh5 hits f7 with the c4-bishop, and if Black grabs the rook, the queen check, Bg5+ and long castling bring every white piece into the attack.

name: Scotch 4...Nxd4 5.Qxd4 c5?
videoTitle: 7 MOST COMMON Chess Mistakes
idea: Trading on d4 and kicking the queen with ...c5 leaves a hole on d5; White just retreats the queen, plants a knight on d5 and develops the bishops, already clearly better.

name: Englund trap: 3.Nf3 Qe7 4.Bf4 Qb4+ 5.Bd2 Qxb2 6.Bc3? Bb4 7.Qd2 Bxc3 8.Qxc3 Qc1#
videoTitle: WIN IN 8 MOVES: The Englund Gambit
idea: ...Qe7 hits e5 twice; when White defends with Bf4, the queen check forks bishop, king and b2. After ...Qxb2 and Bc3, the pin ...Bb4 overloads the white queen and the black queen mates on c1.

name: Englund main: 6.Nc3 Bb4 7.Rb1 Qa3 8.Nd5 Ba5 9.Rb5
videoTitle: WIN IN 8 MOVES: The Englund Gambit
idea: The best defense: Nc3 and Rb1 chase the queen, Nd5 hits c7 and the bishop, and only the precise Rb5 keeps White on top; one wrong move here and the black queen and bishop break through.

name: Englund 6.Nc3 Nb4 7.Rc1? Nxa2
videoTitle: WIN IN 8 MOVES: The Englund Gambit
idea: The knight jump to b4 eyes c2; if White guards c2 with the rook and forgets a2, Black takes on a2 and escapes all danger with material back.

name: Legal's mate: 3...Nc6 4.Nc3 Bg4? 5.h3 Bh5? 6.Nxe5
videoTitle: EASY Chess Trap!
idea: When the bishop pins the f3-knight to the queen, h3 asks it to decide; if it keeps the pin with ...Bh5, Nxe5 breaks it, and grabbing the queen allows Bxf7+ and a knight mate on d5.

name: Ponziani 8...dxe5 9.cxb7+ Bd7 10.Bxd7+ Qxd7 11.bxa8=Q
videoTitle: NASTY Chess Trap
idea: Taking the e5-knight opens the a4-e8 diagonal; the pawn capture on b7 is a discovered check, and after the block and trade on d7 the pawn promotes on a8.

name: Vienna 2...Bb4 3.Qg4 Qf6? 4.Nd5
videoTitle: CHESS STEPS #3 (1000-1400)
idea: With the bishop out early, Qg4 hits g7 as in the copycat line; defending with ...Qf6 runs into Nd5, which attacks the queen, the b4-bishop and the c7 pawn at once.

name: Berlin main line: 4.O-O Nxe4 5.d4 Nd6 6.Bxc6 dxc6 7.dxe5 Nf5 8.Qxd8+
videoTitle: STOP PLAYING These 4 Chess Openings
idea: The Berlin endgame: White castles and lets e4 go, wins the pawn back, and after the queen trade Black has the bishop pair but a king on d8 and doubled c-pawns; Levy shows it as the main line he does not recommend for club players.

name: Rousseau 3...f5 4.exf5 e4 5.Ng1 Nf6
videoTitle: Learn This Chess Trick. Crush Everyone.
idea: Against the Italian bishop, hit back with ...f5; if White takes, ...e4 leaves the f3-knight no safe square except home, and Black develops with ...Nf6, ...d5 and the bishop, a big center for a pawn.

name: Rousseau 4.exf5 e4 5.Qe2 Qe7 6.Ng1 Nf6
videoTitle: Learn This Chess Trick. Crush Everyone.
idea: Meet the pin Qe2 by pinning back with ...Qe7; once the knight retreats, ...Nf6 with ...d5 or ...Nd4 (hitting the queen and eyeing c2) is coming.

name: Rousseau 4.Nc3? fxe4 5.Nxe4 d5
videoTitle: Learn This Chess Trick. Crush Everyone.
idea: After the trade on e4 the pawn fork ...d5 hits the bishop and the knight at once.

name: Rousseau 4.d3 Nf6 5.Ng5 d5 6.exd5 b5
videoTitle: Learn This Chess Trick. Crush Everyone.
idea: Against the calm d3, develop the knight; if the knight jumps to g5 toward f7, ...d5 and then ...b5 deflect the c4-bishop, like the Ulvestad in the Two Knights.

name: Rousseau 4.d4 fxe4 5.Nxe5 d5 6.Bb5 Qd6
videoTitle: Learn This Chess Trick. Crush Everyone.
idea: The engine's d4 is met by ...fxe4 hitting the knight; after Nxe5, ...d5 hits the bishop, and when it pins from b5, ...Qd6 defends the c6-knight and keeps Black's big center.

name: Rousseau 6.Qh5+? g6 7.Nxg6 Nf6 8.Qh4 Nxd4
videoTitle: Learn This Chess Trick. Crush Everyone.
idea: The scary queen check is met by ...g6; the knight sacrifice on g6 is answered by ...Nf6 hitting the queen, and ...Nxd4 leaves White's pieces hanging with c2 under fire.

name: Traxler: 7.Ke3 Qh4 8.d3? Qf4+ 9.Ke2 Qf2#
videoTitle: EVERY Chess Gambit for White and Black | Chess Opening Tips
idea: With the white king on e3, kicking the e4-knight with d3 is a blunder: the queen checks from f4 and mates on f2, guarded by the knight.

name: Latvian Gambit 3.exf5 e4
videoTitle: EVERY Chess Gambit for White and Black | Chess Opening Tips
idea: If White takes the f-pawn, push ...e4 to kick the knight, then build with ...Nf6, ...d5 and ...c5; Levy flags the gambit as close to refuted against a prepared opponent.
